line: Crowley’s Two of Disks: Change, Chokmah in the suit of Earth, Jupiter and Capricornus.

sections.title: What Crowley names
sections.line: The old name was Lord of Harmonious Change, and the card is now called Change. The second quotation gives the element of its suit.

quotes.quote: The Two of Pentacles was of old time called the Lord of Harmonious Change.

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: The number Two, Chokmah, rules in the suit pertaining to Earth, and the Twos essay refers all four Twos to Chokmah.

quotes.quote: The number Two, Chokmah, here rules in the suit pertaining to Earth.

sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley reads the card as the complete manifested Universe in its dynamics, with the interplay of the four elements in movement.

quotes.quote: One may in fact consider the card as the picture of the complete manifested Universe
They thus represent the harmonious interplay of the Four Elements in constant movement.

sections.title: Conflicts and gaps
sections.line: The chapter names the pair Jupiter and Capricornus, where the attribution table (pdf 275, image only, not quoted) reads Jupiter in Capricorn. This page keeps the text reading.

quotes.quote: Its celestial rulers are Jupiter and Capricornus
these symbols are most inharmonious, so that in practical matters the good fortune of Jupiter is very limited.
